'Fate/kaleid liner Prisma☆Illya Finale' TV Anime Airs in 2027
The official website of the Fate/kaleid liner Prisma☆Illya franchise revealed a second teaser visual (pictured) for the sequel anime on Monday. Titled Fate/kaleid liner Prisma☆Illya Finale, the television anime is scheduled to premiere in 2027. The lead cast and main staff from the previous installments are reprising their roles. Manga 'Yurayura Q' Receives TV Anime Adaptation
Production company Nikkatsu announced a television anime adaptation of Gido Amagakure's Yurayura Q (Yura Yura Queen) manga on Monday, revealing a teaser visual (pictured). Amagakure originally published the supernatural comedy manga as two one-shots before beginning regular serialization in The Hana to Yume magazine in October 2019. 'Kino no Tabi' Creator Launches New Manga
Light novel author Keiichi Sigsawa began serializing his first original manga with manga author Hayato Asaki titled Kemono-tachi no Peregrinatio (Peregrinatio Bestiarum) on the Weekly CoroCoro Comic website on Friday. Sigsawa began serializing the Kino no Tabi: The Beautiful World (Kino's Journey: The Beautiful World) light novel on the Dengeki hp magazine with illustrations by Kouhaku Kurobochi in March 2000.
